in_sanskrit.name: Varinder
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave, Manly
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Varinder एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Varinder is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vri' which means man and 'Indra' which is the name of the Hindu God of Rain, Thunder, and Power. The name Varinder is a combination of 'Vri' and 'Indra' and signifies a manly and brave individual.
